Uber has commenced operations of Europe’s first fully driverless robotaxi service in Croatia, which utilizes Chinese software and zero human safety drivers [Uber commenced operations](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxQQ09uc1FWTGJmNVBER3NyVENJMHVfYWJYcENNdjhsc3dRSkxDejFYdmdOSUFvM1dMNHlCNzVTc0sxZWJzdEdmWmZ1NXZzRmx5aElBR09JZ3U5OURvVFdpVGc1SURETkl1MmwzQ0dmeXV5OUkyQXBZMC03Rl9oYU9kWnN6RHpDOFJFTzVXdW5QbEVSanlMTzBnWnlHaVJFXzhsN1BUbHkteGdJeXJzeU5zNWlLSlVoMkc4NTJLdg?oc=5). This launch coincides with a broader trend of autonomous vehicle commercialization, as Tesla launched its first Cybercab robotaxis in Texas [Tesla launched Cybercabs](https://theticker.org/news/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxNVTdTeWNxeE9xLWkwZGxqQmlCVUQ2T1hOQ2x2WFFtaFNhWmhnWVJZbTQ1MEotWWZXTUh0V3lnX3IwQU5pSERvbnhmRGo3cFJWenFXVU5YT0hrQkR4U1FQN2t6R1FtLVZDY0ZtdERROGlwMWJGTWtZd2prZnRpTmJDalBjdERKWnBjUUs2WnYzUQ?oc=5) and the Volkswagen ID. Buzz robotaxi began operating on streets in Los Angeles.

In the advanced air mobility sector, the Texas Department of Transportation confirmed that air taxis are taking flight this fall under a new federal program [TxDOT confirmed flights](https://news.google.?oc=5). Additionally, Joby Aviation completed its first electric vertical takeoff and landing flights from JFK to Manhattan.

Defense technology developments include a surge in counter-drone activity. Sweden’s Freya Industries raised $620,000 to scale drone detection across Europe, and Poland unveiled the MAKO X1 man-portable counter-UAS system [Freya Industries raised seed funding](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxQSHNlWGpoNDFXZV81OWlWRWVWSVVBd1ZmSmFYNnVEWjJFYkNfdjI0eWdXY2pWM2VvZ0Q2bFVlZG5kUzRfV0dPcy1UQ005RGc1VEl6bjZYdkpTX0hQakd2anlpWGJUOVk0S2J2bUdXYS1NVTYyZHFiQVBQNzlXaGp5THg3bnVkdUVaLVRXbnFHQW1DUDlNQ2VVZHBVZFlGY3Z4MXZwMnBBbGV2OHplNlI1dlRGVnJkdw?oc=5). Meanwhile, the European Union released $7 billion for Ukraine to purchase drones and Patriot missiles.

Geopolitical conflicts continue to impact transportation infrastructure. Russian drone strikes hit a train near the Polish border, and drones from Iraq targeted a Saudi oil pipeline [Russian drones hit train](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5). In rail, Russia proposed building its Ivolga FG high-speed trains in India.
